implementationSummary: CI-WAVE-2: reworked .github/workflows/pr.yml per ADR-052. classify-tier emits a main_via_wave output (true when main-tier is reached via a feature/*-wave head, i.e. wave->main). lint/typecheck/frontend/demo-frontend skip on main tier when main_via_wave is true, closing the CI double-run from the #658 audit addendum (status-check and deployment-checks allow their 'skipped' result). validate-artifacts and generate-validation-artifact (heavy per-issue meta_prepare_executor/check_*.py re-run) were removed from issue tier entirely per ADR-052 point 6. ai-review was renamed to artifact-gate, deferred to tier=='main' only, and calls agent-runtime/scripts/ci/wave_manifest.py --check-artifacts (the CI-WAVE-1 validator). policy-checks calls wave_manifest.py --issue to enforce manifest membership. gitleaks remains unconditional. REWORK (#660, maintainer-approved AC narrowing per gh issue view 660 comments, kept mechanical/scoped): (1) AC2 retired as a documented no-op -- removed the skip_unchanged_head output and every skip_unchanged_head != 'true' gate on lint/typecheck/test/frontend/demo-frontend/policy-checks, since GitHub only fires pull_request 'synchronize' when the head SHA moves, so before == after is unreachable and a base-only base advance fires no PR event at all; added an inline comment on classify-tier documenting that sibling base-reruns are instead prevented by ADR-052's removal of 'up-to-date-with-base' on feature/*-wave. (2) AC6 narrowed to the pull_request path -- removed the merge_group branch of the main_via_wave wave_head derivation (MERGE_GROUP_HEAD_REF compared against a synthetic gh-readonly-queue/... ref that never matches feature/*-wave, so it was dead code); kept the working pull_request wave->main dedup intact; merge_group re-running those four jobs is an accepted safe over-run tracked in follow-up #671. All other #660 behavior (issue-tier minimal job set, ai-review->artifact-gate rename, removed validate-artifacts/generate-validation-artifact, policy-checks manifest-membership, unconditional gitleaks, tier-aware status-check, the #670 artifact-gate read-path seam) is untouched.
assumptions: Direct-to-main/staging PRs not originating from a feature/*-wave head branch are treated as main_via_wave=false and still run lint/typecheck/frontend/demo-frontend at main tier (no issue-tier run preceded them, so no double-run to dedup).

REWORK (#660): the maintainer's AC narrowing comment on issue #660 constitutes explicit approval to retire AC2 as a documented no-op and to scope AC6's dedup to the pull_request path only, deferring the merge_group case to #671.
risks: actionlint could not be executed against a live GitHub Actions run; only static lint + yaml parse + job-graph consistency were verified locally (no repo network to trigger an actual PR event).
